sensitivity.title: Screening sensitivity
sensitivity.description: How closely a customer name must match a sanctioned name to flag.

watchlists.title: Watchlists
watchlists.description: Which sanctions lists to screen against. Disabling a list removes its matches on the next re-screen.
watchlists.ageUnknown: Age unknown — this list cannot say when it was last refreshed

cache.title: Cached lists
cache.description: Verified watchlists are cached on this device, so a later visit starts fast instead of re-downloading them. Clearing the cache frees space; the next load re-fetches and re-verifies every list.
cache.cleared: Cached lists cleared — the next load re-fetches and re-verifies.

banner.applied: Settings applied — no customers needed re-screening.
banner.unchanged: Settings unchanged — no changes to apply.

signingKey.title: Receipt signing key
signingKey.description: Every score receipt is signed with this browser's own key. Anyone with the public key below can check that a receipt was not changed after it was signed. The key is kept in this browser's local SQLite database and never leaves the device unless you export it.
signingKey.unavailable: The signing key can't be loaded here: {{reason}}
signingKey.publicKeyLabel: Public key (share this to let others check your receipts)
signingKey.memoryNotice: This browser refused persistent storage, so the signing key lives only in this tab and is lost when you close it. Receipts you make now can only be checked later if you export the key below.

export.title: Export the key
export.description: Saves the key to a file, encrypted with a passphrase you choose (at least {{min}} characters). The file is useless without the passphrase, and the passphrase can't be recovered, so keep both safe.

import.title: Import a key
import.description: Replaces this browser's key with the one in an export file, for example when you move to a new computer. Receipts signed with the current key will then only verify with its public key, so export it first if you still need it.

errors.wrongPassphrase: Wrong passphrase, or the file was changed. Nothing was imported.
errors.malformed: That is not a signing-key file. Nothing was imported.
errors.unsupported: This key file comes from a newer version of the app. Nothing was imported.
errors.mismatch: The key inside this file doesn't match its public key. Nothing was imported.

reset.warning: Resetting deletes this key and makes a new one. Receipts signed before the reset can then only be verified with the public key you exported or wrote down (shown above). Export the key first if you may need to prove old receipts.
reset.confirm: Delete the key and make a new one
reset.done: Signing key reset. New public key: {{publicKey}}
